en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Hussain ibn Hasan bin Aban, from Husain bin Sa’eed, from Hammad bin Isa, from Rab’i, from Muhammed bin Muslim, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Then, let them end their tafath» [22:29]. He said: The cutting of the moustache and nails.
